messages:
alex: quick watercooler: is 1.0.0.0 a semver or a cry for help? :eyes:
maria: semver's horror story. also: YAML wrote a one line tragedy today.
jin: i saw `version: 1.0.0.0-alpha` and cried into my keyboard.
ci-bot: pipeline alert: lint/semver failed on PR#555 — Invalid versions: ["1.0.0.0"]
humor-bot: meme incoming: "When your YAML decides to be modern art" (image)
alex: paste of the offending YAML:
```
service:
  name: foobar
  replicas: 2
   env:
    - FOO=bar
```
maria: the extra space before env is the ghost of tabs past.
jin: propose: pre-commit hook that converts 1.0.0.0 -> 1.0.0 and turns stray tabs into spaces. also leaves a tiny apology commit.
ci-bot: created issue infra/1345 "pre-commit: semver & yamllint" assigned to @infra
alex: sticker idea: "Semver Referee — calls, flags, and gentle reformatting"
maria: t-shirt: "I indent therefore I am"
humor-bot: reaction: :laughing:
jin: workshop: "Semver & YAML survival skills" next Tues? react :raised_hands: if yes
alex: :raised_hands:
maria: :raised_hands:
